armitage-by-wintermute.finding: Armitage lists Prime and Select separately. Inspect the Ethereum Select allocations. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

axis.finding: Origin Vault lists USDT, USDC and USDx. Coordinates are vault rewards. A dated exit schedule and jurisdiction terms were not established.

b14g.finding: The portal describes a BTC security mechanism. Confirm the supported dual-staking pair, locking contract and release terms before funding.

bitfi-basis.finding: Current issuer page advertises a BFI claim and bfUSD strategies. The sealed snapshot label predates this evidence. No new-token opportunity is inferred.

bittensor-dtao.finding: TAO staking supports subnet positions. Subnet alpha assets and TAO already exist. The aggregate row does not identify a distinct new-token route.

cian-yield-layer.finding: Select a CIAN stETH Yield Layer deployment. Verify supported inputs, caps, gas and exact withdrawal terms for that vault.

clearstar.finding: Match the Arc USDC vault. A similarly named vault accepts vbUSDC. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

curvance.finding: The transparency page explains that Earn Vaults allocate one underlying asset across approved two-asset markets. Confirm the selected vault liquidity and local terms.

defi-saver-asset-management.finding: DeFi Saver manages existing positions across third-party protocols. Costs and exit depend on the underlying position and any automation. No distinct campaign was verified.

doppler-finance.finding: Check jurisdiction first: the XRP Vault excludes US users and sanctioned regions.

ember.finding: Select a specific Ember vault and inspect its underlying asset and strategy.

figure-markets-prime.finding: Verify account and jurisdiction eligibility for the Prime lending marketplace.

firelight.finding: Check the FXRP vault on Flare and its coverage exposure. Reserve FLR for gas. Request unstaking, then return to claim FXRP after the window. Check period boundaries and redemption value.

galaxy-curation.finding: Select the Arc listing. Quality, Enhanced and PYUSD are distinct products. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

gami-labs.finding: Locate Gami USDC on Lagoon. Confirm the named curator, address and public or private access.

gauntlet.finding: Identify a Gauntlet-curated Morpho vault. Compare its market allocations, collateral exposure, accepted asset, cap and withdrawable liquidity.

hive-protocol.finding: The official B2 Hive app returned a regional access restriction. No route was verified for this access context.

hyperithm.finding: The directory lists several Apex deployments and V1 variants. Verify the exact chain and version. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

infinifi.finding: The issuer code describes iUSD minted against USDC and a redemption controller. Current deployment status, reserve liquidity and a usable withdrawal quote remain unverified.

k3-capital.finding: K3 says its US site is in preparation and offers no services to US residents through that site. Confirm eligibility directly before any funding.

keyrock.finding: Check the Keyrock Prime listing, vault owner and chain in the directory. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

lagoon.finding: Identify an asynchronous Lagoon vault, the accepted asset, curator, fee settings and deposit permissions.

lightning-network.finding: Prepare a compatible Lightning node or wallet with bitcoin, on-chain fee budget and a suitable peer. Check channel backup and monitoring requirements.

lofty.finding: Confirm marketplace account requirements and review the chosen property's share terms, expenses, vacancy exposure and recent order activity.

mellow-core.finding: Match the deployment to the permissionless ERC20RootVault generation and verify its configured tokens and deposit permissions. Preview burning LP against the lower TVL estimate. Check per-block limits and the assets available from subvaults.

mezo-earn.finding: Locking MEZO requires MEZO and BTC for gas and produces a veMEZO NFT. This is an existing-token governance mechanism. A separate Earn token was not evidenced.

noble.finding: The site identifies Noble Dollar infrastructure. Holding or transferring a stablecoin does not establish a protocol-specific incentive or an exit quote.

nonce-capital.finding: Nonce links its Deposit and EtherFi Earn experiences. Confirm the exact strategy, receipt, custody and withdrawal path before routing a deposit.

onre.finding: Check access terms and redemption conditions. The FAQ describes ONyc minting with supported USDC or USDG through a compatible Solana wallet.

opentrade.finding: The infrastructure supports approved users and allowlisted wallets; distributors control product terms and redemption. Identify the exact distributor and agreement.

plume-vaults.finding: Select a Plume vault and verify which of USDC, USDT or pUSD it accepts, the supported network and any access requirements.

polymarket-international.finding: Check international platform access for your location and read the market resolution rules before considering a position. Check available bids to sell, or redeem winning tokens after resolution. A losing position can exhaust principal.

r25.finding: R25 lists a vault studio and curated strategies. Creating a vault requires curator eligibility; the landing page does not identify depositor exit terms for a specific vault.

reti-pooling.finding: Inspect the validator, pool minimum and any asset or NFT gating criteria.

rockawayx.finding: Distinguish USDC Yield from its Confidential RWA and ecosystem vaults. Check interface eligibility and available withdrawal liquidity.

saturn.finding: The USDat interface shows mint, swap and stake paths and points, and restricts participation to eligible persons outside the US. Review the fee, price impact and minimum received per quote.

sentora-curator.finding: For the Sentora Tempo Morpho route, verify the exact vault, pathUSD supply asset, gas asset, cap and access before funding.

shift-defi.finding: Select the vault version, underlying deposit asset and available capacity in the Shift app.

steakhouse-financial.finding: Steakhouse documents vaults on Morpho and Kamino. Identify the specific Steakhouse vault and verify its network, deposit asset, cap, available liquidity and curator permissions.

symbiotic.finding: Verify the specific vault's single collateral token, deposit access, operator and network exposure, slashing policy and epoch duration.

tori-finance.finding: Distinguish market swaps from direct minting. Identity verification applies to direct mint and redeem.

tulipa-capital.finding: Select Tulipa USDC on Lagoon and verify the exact vault identity and access terms.

tydro.finding: Tydro offers supply and borrowing on Ink. Check the reserve asset, utilization and withdrawable liquidity. Adding borrowing introduces liquidation risk.

upshift.finding: Select an Upshift vault and verify its input asset, curator, fees and withdrawal conditions. Review strategy and NAV risk.

usdd.finding: The guide covers TRON. Check the collateral type, debt terms and liquidation threshold. Use TronLink with sufficient TRX for transaction costs.

valos.finding: Valos describes managed credit and absolute-return strategies with a contact workflow. A public deposit or redemption process was not established.

veda.finding: Identify the specific Veda BoringVault product. Verify its Teller configuration, supported asset and share terms in the product documentation.

yuzu-money.finding: Alpha exposes senior syzUSD and junior yzPP tranches, while Prime uses leveraged RWA assets. Confirm tranche-specific eligibility, redemption and loss priority.

loopscale-lending.finding: Select a single-asset Loopscale vault on Lend. Inspect its curator, collateral and idle-liquidity buffer. Check free LP balance. Compare the immediate exit quote with the queue and extra capital-days. Pledged LP is unavailable until debt is repaid.
